Guard the [[Apostate]] as he recovers his things.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Escort the Apostate while he retrieves his writings.
* Protect the Apostate from the [[Margonite Stalker]]!
* See Apostate for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* 75 [[Lightbringer Points]]

==Walkthrough==
Carefully follow the Apostate in the [[Domain of Fear]] and avoid over-[[aggro]]. He sometimes stops and waits for you (he runs quicker as he isn't affected by [[Cower in Fear]]). Also, he is not targeted by foes, so you do not have to worry about his safety. Moving near him should make him start running again. Expect a fight when you reach your destination. There will be a Margonite Stalker and 5 Margonite Bowmasters to deal with. The fight should be fairly simple.

If you want to play it safe, start this quest from the [[Gate of Secrets]] and clear the pathway to the Apostate, then you can just follow him back to the end point and not worry about accidental aggro. This method will only add a couple of extra minutes to the quest.

If he completely stops moving, simply continue running to the endpoint near the entrance to [[Gate of Secrets]] to get him to move as well.

:''"Thank you for protecting me. And for your help, I shall now fulfill my end of the bargain.''

==Notes==
*The Apostate will sometimes heal you and your enemies using [[Divine Intervention]], and remove your and your enemies' conditions with [[Dismiss Condition]].
*This quest has good synergy with the primary quest [[Kormir's Crusade]].
